operating_notes.text: Unit IV greenfield expansion at Harohalli involves a Phase I investment of ₹1,200 Cr adding 365 KL custom synthesis and 100 KL fermentation capacity.
Unit utilisation in Q1FY27: Unit 1 ~78% (custom synthesis), Unit 2 ~50% (custom synthesis) and ~50% (fermentation), Unit 3 30-35% versus ~15% in FY26.
60% of the full-year order book is already in hand for the whole business, largely CRDMO; specialty ingredients runs on rolling 3-6 month forecasts.
Pipeline: 100+ early-stage programmes and 10 late-phase molecules, with path to commercialisation about 18-24 months away; customers commercialised 4 new molecules last year.
